spec.name: claude-enforcement-scope
spec.intent: ASSAY FOLLOW-UP (8f1abc6b, agent://AssayEnforcementScope): (a) SubagentStop judges the text of the agent its scope names: read agent_transcript_path when present, never the parent's transcript_path. (b) On Claude Code the final assistant message is not yet in the transcript at Stop: judge Stop from the payload's last_assistant_message when present, so a text-only turn is judged and a tool turn is judged on its close. (c) Scope is fixed by composition: a persona's manifest enrolls exactly the enforcing cells its composition includes, taken from the composed agent, never every cell for every persona; non-guard cells (deploy-drift-notice) are never listed. (d) A harness that registers enforcing hooks but cannot name the running agent (no scopedRel) degrades to a steer and warns once per cell at projection and install. (e) omp purview on tool.use.pre receives an empty tool_name and always allows: fix the omp dispatch so the arm judges. (f) One sign for the artifact: 'stance manifest' (the gloss's word and the path's); rename EnrollmentManifest/enrollment wording, label it 'stance manifest' in the install log instead of 'mechanism', and have the three workers take the manifest path from the one constant instead of spelling it.
accept: live claude: a bare session dispatching planner is not judged, and planner's own close is (quote the judged payload)
live claude: a text-only --agent mav turn is judged at Stop, and a tool turn's judged payload contains its closing text
a fixture persona composing no guard gets no stance manifest entry for any guard and is not judged; no manifest lists deploy-drift-notice
projecting through an adapter with enforcing hooks and no scopedRel prints one warning per guard naming the cell and the harness
omp: a mav tool.use.pre envelope reaches purview with the real tool_name and is judged (stand-in judge)
